description: Simulation analysis horizon
range: 2027-01-01 to 2050-12-31 in the current analysis
source_note: Calendar-defined 2027-01-01 to 2050-12-31 horizon, bounded by the embedded WPP 2024 demographic support; this is an analysis-design choice, not a literature-estimated parameter.

description: Fixed calendar origin for historical state reconstruction
range: 2005-01-01 fixed calendar origin; prospective policy t0=2027-01-01

description: Time interval between saved model outputs
range: 7 days in production output; calibration saves every 30 days
source_note: Weekly saved output supports annualised summaries while calibration can use coarser monthly saved output for speed.

description: Relative tolerance for the RK45 ODE solver
range: 1e-5 production; 1e-4 calibration
source_note: Production tolerance used by the RK45 solver; calibration uses a slightly looser tolerance for repeated likelihood evaluations.

description: Absolute tolerance for the RK45 ODE solver
range: 1e-7 production; 1e-6 calibration
source_note: Production absolute tolerance used by the RK45 solver; calibration uses a slightly looser tolerance for repeated likelihood evaluations.

description: Transmission rate for macrolide-sensitive pertussis
range: Country-calibrated; bounded calibration support 0.002 to 0.20
source_note: Baseline placeholder in the shared configuration; country-specific sensitive-strain transmission coefficients are calibrated to reported surveillance and reported separately in the calibration diagnostics.

description: Relative infectiousness of asymptomatic infection
range: Fixed in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Human household evidence does not identify this ratio; it is varied only in dedicated structural diagnostics.

description: Relative transmission fitness of macrolide-resistant infections
range: 0.7 to 1.25 (truncated-lognormal support)
source_note: Baseline is fitness-neutral; surveillance does not separately identify biological transmission fitness.

description: Annual cosine forcing amplitude
range: Fixed in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Country profiles override this from circular seasonal concentration of reported cases.

description: Day-of-year phase for annual cosine forcing
range: Country-specific processed value when inferred; shared default day 30
source_note: Country profiles override the shared default when seasonal timing can be inferred from reported-case timing.

description: Target/diagnostic inter-epidemic period
range: 3 to 5 years when country surveillance supports recurrence; otherwise fixed at 4 years
source_note: Country profiles infer 3-5-year periodicity from annual surveillance peaks when visible; otherwise use 4 years.

description: Weak multi-year phase-locking amplitude
range: Fixed in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Weak phase-locking is a zero-versus-enabled structural choice rather than a literature-estimated continuous parameter.

description: Phase of optional multi-year recurrence forcing
range: Fixed at 0 in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Optional multi-year recurrence phase is fixed in the submitted primary analysis.

description: Latent period duration
range: 4 to 21 days (truncated-lognormal support)
source_note: Two outbreak analyses give materially different incubation estimates; their broad synthesis is an explicit proxy for the unobserved latent-period mean.

description: Symptomatic infectious duration
range: 14 to 35 days (truncated-lognormal support)
source_note: The evidence-prior PSA encodes uncertainty around a fitted 3.7-week mean.

description: Asymptomatic infectious duration
range: Derived as 0.2 to 0.999 times the sampled symptomatic duration (beta ratio support)
source_note: Human studies establish asymptomatic infection but do not identify its duration relative to symptomatic infection.

description: Duration of short-lived maternally derived infant protection
range: 90 days baseline; 180 days in pregnancy Tdap scale-up; 90 to 270 days in Figure 2c intervention prior
source_or_assumption: Pregnancy-vaccination effectiveness evidence and scenario assumption
source_note: Baseline passive maternal-protection duration is short-lived; pregnancy Tdap and Figure 2c intervention priors vary the duration.

description: Duration of post-infection protection
range: Legacy fallback only; inactive under the submitted SIRWS boosting model
source_note: This field is inactive when SIRWS boosting is enabled; active natural-immunity uncertainty is applied to the R-to-W and W-to-S stages.

description: Duration of vaccine-derived protection proxy
range: 365 to 2190 days per stage (half of sampled total vaccine-origin protection duration)
source_note: This is an explicit duration mapping rather than a directly observed duration distribution.

description: Duration before fully immune recovered state moves to waned-but-boostable state
range: 1825 to 1.825e+04 days per stage (half of sampled total natural-immunity duration)
source_or_assumption: Pertussis waning and immune-boosting model evidence
source_note: Equal R and W stages approximate an Erlang shape-2 total natural-immunity residence time when boosting is absent.

description: Duration before waned-but-boostable state loses residual natural immunity
range: 1825 to 1.825e+04 days per stage (half of sampled total natural-immunity duration)
source_or_assumption: Pertussis waning and immune-boosting model evidence
source_note: Equal R and W stages approximate an Erlang shape-2 total natural-immunity residence time when boosting is absent.

description: Fraction of waned-natural exposure events that restore immunity
range: 0 to 1 admissible; fixed at 0.70 in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Controls what fraction of re-exposure events boost waned-natural immunity back toward the recovered state.

description: Susceptibility scalar for the waned-natural-immunity state
range: 0 to 1 admissible; fixed at 0.35 in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Susceptibility scalar for waned-natural-immunity breakthrough infection after failed boosting.

description: Relative vaccine-effect weight assigned to waned vaccine-origin histories
range: 0 to 1 admissible; fixed at 0.35 in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Residual vaccine-effect weight assigned to waned vaccine-origin states.

description: Relative vaccine-effect weight assigned to maternal-protection origin histories
range: 0 to 1 admissible; fixed at 0.75 in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Relative vaccine-effect weight assigned to the maternal-protection origin.

description: Relative vaccine-effect weight assigned after one primary-series dose
range: 0 to 1 admissible; fixed at 0.45 in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Relative vaccine-effect weight assigned after one primary-series dose.

description: Relative vaccine-effect weight assigned after two primary-series doses
range: 0 to 1 admissible; fixed at 0.75 in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Relative vaccine-effect weight assigned after two primary-series doses.

description: Duration of residual protection for waned vaccine-origin histories
range: 365 to 2190 days per stage (half of sampled total vaccine-origin protection duration)
source_note: The sampled total duration is split equally between recent and waned vaccine-origin stages.

description: Fallback fraction of vaccinated-origin people initialized as recently protected
range: Age-specific initial fractions 0.06 to 1.00; shared fallback 0.35
source_note: Shared fallback for the fraction of vaccinated-origin individuals initialized as recently protected; age-specific values override it.

description: Baseline symptom_protective reduction in susceptibility to infection
range: Fixed in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Human effectiveness studies do not separately identify acquisition and symptom effects; VE_sus is fixed by the selected mechanism scenario in the evidence-prior PSA.

description: Baseline symptom_protective reduction in symptomatic disease given infection
range: Derived from overall vaccine disease efficacy; 0.7 to 0.97 (complement-truncated-lognormal support)
source_note: VE_sym is derived conditional on scenario VE_sus so acquisition and symptom effects are not sampled independently.

description: Baseline symptom_protective reduction in onward infectiousness
range: Fixed in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Human evidence supports residual transmission but does not identify an independent VE_inf distribution.

description: Baseline symptom_protective reduction in infectious duration
range: Fixed in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: No human study identifies an independent infectious-duration vaccine effect.

description: Low-level imported infections per 100,000 persons per year
range: Bounded calibration support 0.01 to 2.00
source_note: Low-level imported infection seeding prevents deterministic extinction and is bounded in calibration support.

parameter: Target resistant fraction at analysis start
description: Macrolide-resistant fraction after burn-in rebalance
range: Country-timeline anchor or fixed scenarios 0.05, 0.30, 0.70, and 0.95
source_or_assumption: Country resistance evidence and fixed stress-test scenarios
source_note: Country-timeline analyses use the latest admissible country-specific resistance anchor; fixed scenarios retain low-to-very-high contrasts.

description: Fraction of imported infections assigned to the resistant strain
range: Country-timeline anchor or fixed scenarios 0.05, 0.30, 0.70, and 0.95
source_or_assumption: Country resistance evidence and fixed stress-test scenarios
source_note: The resistant fraction among imports follows the country-timeline or fixed resistance-scenario anchor.

description: Annual rate used during burn-in rebalance toward evidence-based resistant fraction
range: Fixed at 2.0 per year for country-timeline anchoring
source_note: Burn-in rebalance rate used to move strain composition toward the evidence-based analysis-start anchor.

description: Whether burn-in output is rebalanced to the evidence-based resistant fraction
range: Enabled in country-timeline analyses
source_note: Submitted country-timeline analyses rebalance resistant prevalence after burn-in to match the evidence anchor.

description: Observation-layer probabilities converting symptomatic cases to reported cases
range: Country- and age-specific calibrated probabilities; prior bounds reported in the fitted reporting-probability table
source_or_assumption: Age-specific reporting priors and country calibration
source_note: Baseline age-specific reporting probabilities are country-calibrated and reported in the fitted reporting-probability table.

description: Country-calibrated multiplier applied to age-specific reporting probabilities
range: 0.5 to 1.5 (truncated-lognormal support)
source_or_assumption: Calibrated observation layer plus transfer prior
source_note: The evidence-prior factor is applied around the calibrated country value and assessed only against reported cases.

description: Dispersion parameter for reported-case likelihood
range: Fixed at 50 in the negative-binomial likelihood; stochastic overlay explores k=5 to 50 separately
source_note: Dispersion parameter used in the reported-case calibration likelihood.

description: Number of recent surveillance years used for calibration when available
range: Up to 6 recent observed years when available
source_note: Number of recent surveillance years used by the staged calibration objective when available.

description: Retained-fit tolerance for model-to-observed mean reported incidence
range: Fixed at 0.25 for retained mean-incidence calibration
source_note: Maximum tolerated relative deviation of modeled from observed mean annualised reported incidence during retained calibration.

description: Annual relaxation rate toward age-specific vaccine-origin targets
range: 2.0 per year baseline; 6.0 per year in routine-timeliness sensitivity
source_note: Rate at which routine vaccination relaxes toward age-specific target dose-history origins.

description: Maximum daily fraction moved from unvaccinated susceptible state into vaccine-origin states
range: 0.01 per day baseline; 0.03 per day in routine-timeliness sensitivity
source_note: Caps daily flow from unvaccinated susceptible states to avoid numerical overshoot in the ODE implementation.

description: Initial exposed infections per 100,000 persons before burn-in
range: Fixed at 1.5 per 100,000 before burn-in
source_note: Low-level exposed seeding at model start; long burn-in reduces dependence on this value.

description: Initial infectious infections per 100,000 persons before burn-in
range: Fixed at 0.6 per 100,000 before burn-in
source_note: Low-level infectious seeding at model start; long burn-in reduces dependence on this value.

description: Initial resistant fraction used before burn-in rebalance
range: Fixed at 0.30 before burn-in; country-timeline analyses rebalance after burn-in
source_note: Starting resistant fraction before burn-in; submitted country-timeline analyses subsequently rebalance to the evidence anchor.

parameter: Treatment initiation rate for symptomatic infection
description: Daily transition from symptomatic infection to treatment
range: Fixed in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: CDC supports early macrolide treatment but does not define the daily treatment transition rate; numeric treatment effects are implementation assumptions evaluated in sensitivity/scenario analyses.

parameter: Treatment initiation rate for asymptomatic infection
description: Daily transition from asymptomatic infection to treatment
range: Fixed low-rate pathway in submitted analyses
source_note: Asymptomatic treatment is assumed rare and is scaled by diagnosis probability in the ODE treatment block; included to keep the treatment-rate implementation traceable to code.

description: Reduction in infectious duration under standard treatment for sensitive infections
range: Fixed at 0.20 for standard sensitive-strain treatment
source_or_assumption: CDC guidance plus treatment-effect implementation assumption
source_note: Standard macrolide treatment is assumed to shorten infectious duration for sensitive infections when started early.

description: Reduction in infectiousness under standard treatment for sensitive infections
range: Fixed at 0.15 for standard sensitive-strain treatment
source_or_assumption: CDC guidance plus treatment-effect implementation assumption
source_note: Standard macrolide treatment is assumed to reduce infectiousness for sensitive infections when started early.

description: Reduction in infectious duration under standard macrolide treatment for resistant infections
range: 0.10 under standard macrolide practice; 0.45 under resistance-guided management
source_note: Standard macrolide management is assumed to shorten resistant infections less than sensitive infections; resistance-guided management varies this.

description: Reduction in infectiousness under standard macrolide treatment for resistant infections
range: 0.05 under standard macrolide practice; 0.35 under resistance-guided management
source_note: Standard macrolide management is assumed to reduce resistant infectiousness less than sensitive infectiousness; resistance-guided management varies this.

description: Dynamic PEP coverage ceiling among close contacts
range: 0.05 to 0.6 (beta-pert support)
source_or_assumption: CDC guidance plus elicited implementation prior
source_note: Guidance identifies priority contacts but does not estimate coverage; the distribution is explicitly an implementation prior.

description: Reduction in susceptible exposure under standard PEP for sensitive infection
range: 0.05 to 0.99 (complement-truncated-lognormal support)
source_note: The prior is centred on 82.3% effectiveness for PEP delivered within seven days.

description: Reduction in susceptible exposure under standard macrolide PEP for resistant infection
range: Fixed in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Standard macrolide PEP for confirmed high-level resistance is not assigned a pseudo-empirical continuous prior.

description: Detection/prevalence proxy threshold for activating PEP reach
range: Fixed at 0.00002 in the submitted primary analysis
source_note: Low detection/prevalence proxy that activates PEP reach in the reduced-form contact-management pathway.
